title: [MTR] Class 378 Pack By Skywalker_6517
description: Adds the class 378 to Minecraft Transit Railway, featuring an accurate interior with longitudinal seating and wider gangways.
body:
Created by Skywalker_6517

This pack adds the Class 378 Capitalstar train operated by London Overground to MTR (Minecraft Transit Railway). The pack includes 2 liveries, and have an accurate seating and door layout. The model is derived from the original class 377 from MTR and uses the original texture from Exokun. 

Derivations made:
- New black livery added
- Widened gangways
- Longitudinal seating
- Functional displays
- Door positioning changed from plug to sliding

If you are interested in the London Overground fleet, feel free to download the [Class 710](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/class-710)
